weightRationale: Availability and observed correctness dominate because a wrong read is worse than a slow one; recovery independence is next because a shared failure domain defeats the failover; integration effort, cost and portability trade off the remaining risk.

providerSwitchProcedure: After three failed five-second probes switch reads to the independent verifier RPC.
Verify the chain id and the finalized checkpoint before resuming reads.

Refuse to promote a statement whose digest does not match the canonical replay.
checkpointReplay: The indexer restore drill replays the canonical event log from the latest finalized checkpoint and compares per-asset balances and digests before promoting a statement.
